# Poolboy

Poolboy maintains software documentation as portable Markdown, then compiles it into a static, agent-readable corpus.

- [Try Poolboy privately](try.md)
- [Set up Poolboy in this repository](start.md)
- [Poolboy documentation entry point](docs/llms.txt)
- [Documentation index](docs/index.md)
- [Signed corpus manifest](docs/graph.json)
- [Installation guide](install.md)
